mods.notes: Copies ScriptHookV.dll and xinput1_4.dll from the zip's bin folder. xinput1_4.dll is the .asi loader GTA V Enhanced uses; dinput8.dll in the same folder is the Legacy loader and is not copied; NativeTrainer.asi is skipped on purpose (Menyoo is the trainer); args.txt is not copied (it switches BattlEye off; turn BattlEye off in the Rockstar Games Launcher yourself, as Menyoo's page asks). NaturalVision Enhanced's Main Package brings its own xinput1_4.dll and replaces this one later (same loader, per the same guide); Leonida backs up Script Hook V's copy, so rolling NVE back restores it. Game builds: the readme of v3889.0/1158.13 lists Enhanced 1.0.811.8, 812.8, 813.11, 814.9, 889.15/19/22, 1013.17/29/33/34 and 1158.13; dev-c.com only offers this newest release. 1.0.1013.20 isn't listed (its changelog entry v3725.0/1013.20 is only 'control natives compatibility'), but it works: tested on the owner's PC on 2026-11-24 (GTA5_Enhanced.exe 1.0.1013.20), ScriptHookV.log said 'INIT: Success, game version is VER_EN_1_0_1013_17' and registered Menyoo.asi and ScriptHookVDotNet.asi. steps: With CodeWalker RPF Explorer, open mods\update\update.rpf\x64\data\cdimages\scaleform_generic.rpf (copy the game's update.rpf to mods\update first if it isn't there), then cellphone_ifruit.ytd (the .ytd, not the .gfx).
Replace icons_spritesheet_ifruit.dds with the one from the download and save the .ytd.
Michael's and Franklin's iFruit phones show the new icons (Trevor's phone is a different brand).

mods.notes: 'replaces the in-game iFruit application icons with iOS 26 app icons. This is a cosmetic modification only'; 'should work for both Enhanced and Legacy, but I've only tested in Enhanced' (1.0, 13 May 2026; checked 2026-11-25 on the author's page). GTA VI's phone is a modern smartphone; this is the closest free look for GTA V's phone. It edits a different file in scaleform_generic.rpf than Bugstar Fixes (minimap textures).

mods.name: AuraV Lite (path tracing)
mods.author: Kypos

steps: Needs an NVIDIA RTX graphics card (path tracing with DLSS Ray Reconstruction): not for a GTX 1070.
Download 'AuraV Lite' (free, no account) at the bottom of its page, not 'AuraV Full (Early Access)', which is for patrons.
Unzip it straight into the game folder, next to GTA5_Enhanced.exe: AuraV.asi, msdmo.dll, nvngx_dlssd.dll and the AuraV folder (it loads itself, no ASI loader needed).

Leonida writes AuraV\AuraV.ini before the first start: its menu key goes to F11 (F10 reloads the GTA VI-Inspired HUD's settings) and its own start-up shortcuts are switched off (Straight To Story Mode does that job), as the HUD's Enhanced guide does it.
In the game: Settings > Graphics, turn on Ray Tracing and NVIDIA DLSS. F11 opens AuraV's menu.
Don't let DLSS Swapper replace the game's DLSS files (the HUD's guide: path tracing can freeze).

AuraV/Key.why: F10 is the GTA VI-Inspired HUD's key for reloading its settings

boot/skip_legal.why: Straight To Story Mode skips the start screens; two skippers fight

mods.notes: Free path-traced lighting, shadows and reflections, a new sky with volumetric clouds and atmosphere, reworked skin lighting, rain on the lens, lightning and heat haze ('AuraV Lite: FREE ... no account needed'; the ocean waves, road spray and water reflections are only in the patron 'Full' edition; checked 2026-11-25 on kyposmods.com). The GTA VI-Inspired HUD's Enhanced guide has an 'Optional: AuraV-Lite' section (tested with AuraV-Lite 0.2.7 and the HUD). Released 5 Oct 2026, on game builds 1.0.1158.x; untested on 1.0.1013.20 and together with VisualV (both change the sky and lighting).
